item.nusmp.stormcaller_staff.lore: A staff of storm cloud and lightning rod. Storm Magic does not come from a book: it comes from the staff.
nusmp.storm.tooltip.use: Use: cast. Sneak + use: next spell.
nusmp.storm.no_energy: Not enough Aura or magicules for %s (need %s).
nusmp.storm.cooldown: The sky is not ready: %s s.
nusmp.storm.sky_full: The sky is full of storms; wait for one to pass.
nusmp.storm.spell.gathering_clouds.desc: A storm cell gathers over the place you look at: a dark cloud rolls in, rain curtains fall and forked bolts strike from it. It drifts slowly the way you faced.
nusmp.storm.spell.downpour.desc: A heavy rain falls on the area: foes are soaked, slowed and weakened, fires are put out, friends are cooled.
nusmp.storm.spell.hailstorm.desc: Hail stones as big as fists fall in volleys on the area; every stone that lands hurts what stands there.
nusmp.storm.spell.thunderhead.desc: A tall black thunderhead builds and throws bolt after bolt at the foes under it, each bolt leaping to the foes standing near its mark.
nusmp.storm.spell.gale_front.desc: A wall of storm wind sweeps out in front of you and shoves everything on its line before it, rain streaming in its wake.
nusmp.storm.spell.storm_surge.desc: A roll of storm water breaks from a low cloud and runs along the ground, throwing foes back and soaking them.
nusmp.storm.spell.twister.desc: A funnel drops from the cloud and walks across the ground, drawing in and lifting what it meets, then throws it out.
nusmp.storm.spell.eye_of_the_storm.desc: The whole sky turns on the place you stand: rain, hail, bolts and gust rings in a wide cell, and in its middle a calm eye where you and your friends are looked after.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_storm.description: Storm Magic is a Fairy Tail magic of the Stormcaller Staff, not a grimoire magic. This grimoire is the old Storm book, kept so that old saves and grimoires still load; it is no longer given out (server config storm.staffOnly).
nusmp.skill.book_storm.description: The old Storm grimoire, kept for old saves and the Kaiser Granvorka captain book: a storm lance, a ring of tempest, the eye of the storm. Storm Magic itself is a Fairy Tail magic: it belongs to the Stormcaller Staff and is no longer rolled for a soul (server config storm.staffOnly).
